<!-- write a brief player introduction below and remove this line -->
I started playing quake in [[1997]] when my friend [[Mizpah]] showed me [[Team Fortress]]. Myself and Mizpah soon rallied a lot more of our friends and we created our own clan, [[Christ's Soldiers]]. Since 1997 I have been played a majority of TF, however in my later quaking years my friend [[Trojan]] introduced me to the world of [[death match]], and I was instantly hooked. Today I play mostly qw dm still participate in Team Fortress pugs occasionally.
